def normalize_name(name: str) -> str:
    if not name:
        return ""
    
    name = name.lower()
    name = name.replace("(", "")
    name = name.replace(")", "")
    name = name.strip()
    
    return name

        ("Alice", "alice"),

    """

    name = re.sub(r'\(.*?\)', '', name)
    name = name.replace(' ', '')
